/**
 * Reproducibility over an arm's replay runs.
 * Cells = pairs x |layerIds|. A cell agrees only when both tokens are equal AND
 * admissible; sentinels never agree, not even with themselves.
 */
export function replayAgreement(texts, layerIds = EXPECTED_LAYER_IDS) {
  const admissible = new Set(VERDICT_EXTRACTION.admissible_tokens)
  const perRun = texts.map((t) => extractLayerVerdicts(t, layerIds).verdicts)
  const pairs = []
  for (let i = 0; i < perRun.length; i += 1) {
    for (let j = i + 1; j < perRun.length; j += 1) pairs.push([i, j])
  }
  let agree = 0
  const disagreements = []
  for (const [i, j] of pairs) {
    for (const id of layerIds) {
      const a = perRun[i][id]
      const b = perRun[j][id]
      const ok = a === b && admissible.has(a)
      if (ok) agree += 1
      else disagreements.push({ pair: [i, j], layer_id: id, a, b })
    }
  }
  const denominator = pairs.length * layerIds.length
  return {
    numerator: agree,
    denominator,
    rate: denominator === 0 ? null : agree / denominator,
    pairs: pairs.length,
    layers: layerIds.length,
    disagreements,
  }
}

/**
 * Build the bwrap argv for one arm. Every store runs with its own network namespace
 * (--unshare-net: loopback only, no route off the host), its own IPC/UTS namespaces, all
 * capabilities dropped and a cleared environment, with exactly one writable path: the arm's

export function buildSandboxArgv ({ storeDir, outDir, roBinds, setenv, command }) {
  const argv = [
    '/usr/bin/bwrap',
    '--unshare-net', '--unshare-ipc', '--unshare-uts', '--unshare-pid',
    '--die-with-parent', '--new-session', '--cap-drop', 'ALL', '--clearenv'

  for (const [src, dst] of roBinds) argv.push('--ro-bind', src, dst)
  argv.push('--bind', storeDir, '/store')
  if (outDir) argv.push('--bind', outDir, '/out')
  argv.push('--proc', '/proc', '--dev', '/dev', '--tmpfs', '/tmp', '--chdir', '/store')
  for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(setenv)) argv.push('--setenv', k, String(v))
  argv.push(...command)
  return argv
}
